glosses: A very large and destructive wave, generally caused by a tremendous disturbance in the ocean, such as an undersea earthquake or volcanic eruption; often a series of waves (a wave train).

examples.text: A tsunami struck Japan recently.

glosses: A large and generally unstoppable surge.

examples.text: It seemed that what started out as a handful of isolated cases gradually turned into a tsunami of complaints.
